limitations: Cached lane fits even-symbol CFO histories and scores odd-symbol CFO; no truth CFO is known.
Bounded actual lane uses historical posterior-sigma weighting and noisy same-frame frequency innovations.
Offline smoother is in-sample in time and is not a causal competitor.
Phase-gated and V2 comparisons are bounded to actual tracker checkpoints; no substituted state filter.
Scored forecast times start at least 20 ms after the seed origin, when acquisition evidence is available.
